newsitem.title: UK: Kvaerner wins $36 mln Norwegian contract.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner wins $36 mln Norwegian contract.

text.p: Kvaerner ASA said on Friday that Kvaerner Mandal has been awarded a $36 million contract by the Royal Norwegian Navy for a sea-going catamaran.
"This contract is very important and makes the future clear for Kvaerner Mandal, which is one of Kvaerner's two fast-craft shipyards in Norway," the Norwegian industrial group said in a statement.

The contract contains an option for the navy to order a series of up to seven of the 47 metre long vessels, which could lead to additional orders worth more than $154 million for Kvaerner Mandal, it added.
